GOOD TO KNOW

What You Should Know

Quick answers to questions about My Guardian Link.

Is My Guardian Link a replacement for 911?+

No. My Guardian Link strengthens, complements and supports 911. It does not replace 911. Call 911 directly whenever you can safely do so.

What happens when I activate Urgent Assist?+

Your urgent signal, available incident details, and precise location when available are shared with your trusted contacts and a live coordinator, who calls to clarify the situation, coordinates next steps, and escalates to 911 when needed.

Can I practice using Urgent Assist?+

Yes. Your annual membership includes two designated Practice Call Tests to become familiar with the service without initiating an emergency response.

Will my trusted contacts know where I am?+

They can receive your available GPS location and incident details to help them understand and respond.

What does membership cost?+

The Single Annual Membership costs $119.88, billed once annually. That is equivalent to $9.99 per month; it is not billed monthly.

What if I change my mind?+

First-time paid members may request a refund during the first 30 days under the refund policy. Cancellation otherwise leaves access active through the paid membership term.

Does my membership support the Laken Hope Foundation?+

Yes. Paid memberships attributed to this campaign support the Foundation through Forward Move’s contribution commitment. Your membership purchase is not itself a tax-deductible charitable donation.
